notes.scope: The four recurring named raid patterns documented for 100 Days At Sea: Ghost Pirate, Buku, Kraken, and Alien raids.
notes.warningEvidence: Exact warning identities are also visible in the four corresponding in-game warning captures indexed by the 100 Days At Sea Fandom media API.
notes.factPolicy: Timing stays qualitative. Exact nights, health, damage, wave sizes, spawn chances, and difficulty numbers are omitted because they are not sufficiently cross-verified.
notes.rewardPolicy: Rewards remain null unless a checked source directly and unambiguously ties a reward to clearing the named raid.
notes.overlapPolicy: This dataset explains the raid system. Individual enemy biographies remain in NPCs and Mobs, while the Bosses collection remains the broader boss and encounter reference.

item.name: Ghost Pirate Raid
item.warning: The ghost pirates are raiding your raft
item.trigger: A raid warning announces the Ghost Pirate attack on the raft.
item.mechanics: Ghost Pirates board and pressure the raft with a mix of melee and ranged attacks.
item.strategy: Keep moving against gunfire, clear ranged pirates early, and use raft defenses or an Auto Turret to limit boarding pressure.
item.distinction: This is a raft raid, not the Ghost Galleon dungeon or Captain Greenbeard fight.
item.cardSummary: Ghost Pirates board the raft with melee and ranged pressure, so clear gunners first and keep the deck defended.

item.name: Buku Raid
item.trigger: A Buku attack can begin with little warning.
item.mechanics: The Buku tribe attacks as a mixed group, with melee fighters advancing while ranged fighters attack from behind them.
item.strategy: Prioritize ranged attackers, then clear the melee group; an Auto Turret can help hold the base while you reposition.
item.cardSummary: The Buku raid mixes advancing melee fighters with ranged pressure and can begin with little warning.

item.name: Kraken Raid
item.warning: The Kraken will be unleashed tonight
item.trigger: The warning announces that the Kraken will attack the raft that night.
item.mechanics: The Kraken creates a major open-sea defense encounter centered on protecting and fighting from the raft.
item.strategy: Prepare weapons, healing, and raft defenses before night, then keep enough deck space to move safely during the attack.
item.distinction: The Kraken sea raid is not the tablet-summoned Ancient Squid boss encounter.
item.cardSummary: A daytime warning gives the crew time to prepare the raft before the Kraken's open-sea attack that night.

item.name: Alien Raid
item.warning: The mothership will attack your base tonight
item.trigger: The mothership warning announces an Alien attack on the base that night.
item.mechanics: Aliens attack the base under the mothership raid warning and create later-run defensive pressure.
item.strategy: Prepare base defenses before night, use an Auto Turret to control incoming pressure, and avoid being surrounded while clearing the attackers.
item.distinction: This row covers the mothership raid against the base, not combat on Alien Islands.
item.cardSummary: The mothership warning signals an Alien assault on the base, making prepared defenses and controlled positioning important.
